label: Pointed Fly
description: A pointed fly finishes the top of the fly placket with a tailored point rather than a square or curved end, adding a subtle decorative shape where the waistband meets the fly. It is a refined detail that signals hand-finishing on bespoke and made-to-measure trousers. The point sits neatly under the waistband closure.

garment.noun: pair of bespoke wool tailored trousers
garment.fabric: fine wool trouser cloth with visible weave
